description: This source file defines a class for monitoring bad pixels using Bokeh plots, including methods for retrieving and visualizing bad pixel data from a database, handling image data, and updating plots. It is part of a larger JWST data quality monitoring system.

classes.name: BadPixelMonitor
classes.description: A class for visualizing bad pixel data using Bokeh, with methods to load data from a database, process images, and update plots related to bad pixels in JWST data.

methods.name: bad_pixel_history
methods.description: Constructs time series data of bad pixels of a specific type from the database.

methods.name: _badpix_image
methods.description: Updates Bokeh plot objects with sample image data from a FITS file.

methods.name: most_recent_coords
methods.description: Returns coordinates of the most recent bad pixels of a specified type.

methods.name: pre_init
methods.description: Initializes default values, loads data, and prepares the monitor object.

methods.name: get_history_data
methods.description: Extracts historical bad pixel data from the database.

methods.name: identify_tables
methods.description: Determines database tables based on instrument name.

methods.name: load_data
methods.description: Queries database for bad pixel data.

methods.name: most_recent_data
methods.description: Finds the most recent bad pixel data entries for darks and flats.

methods.name: _update_badpix_loc_plot
methods.description: Updates plot properties for bad pixel location plots.

methods.name: _update_badpix_v_time
methods.description: Updates plot properties for bad pixel count over time.
